earth_elevation_aster_gdem_v3.dataset_name: ASTER Global Digital Elevation Model V003
earth_elevation_aster_gdem_v3.provider: NASA / METI / ASTER Science Team / LP DAAC
earth_elevation_aster_gdem_v3.coverage_and_resolution: Global land DEM; 1 arc-second posting (approximately 30 m at the equator).
earth_elevation_aster_gdem_v3.used_for: Earth terrain re-ingestion and the supplied ASTER tile set.
earth_elevation_aster_gdem_v3.citation: NASA/METI/AIST/Japan Spacesystems and U.S./Japan ASTER Science Team, ASTER Global Digital Elevation Model V003.

moon_elevation_lola_20m_south_pole.dataset_name: LOLA South Polar Digital Elevation Model

moon_elevation_lola_20m_south_pole.coverage_and_resolution: 80–90 degrees south lunar polar stereographic DEM at 20 m/pixel.
